meta.title: Draft bids that were never sent are discarded when bidding ends
gaps: The available operations cannot verify that the inactive draft bid is absent from the buyer's bid list.
warnings: verify 3: read_bid's reply shape has not been sampled; "status" is unverified

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for only about two minutes.
steps: The invited QA vendor opens a bid on the pricing round.
Wait until the round has closed (bid end and extra closing time over).
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that Data check: “status” equals closed.
As the buyer, read the event and check that Data check: “status” equals in_active.
As the invited QA vendor, read the bid and check that Data check: “status” equals inactive.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Data check: “status” equals closed; Data check: “status” equals in_active; Data check: “status” equals inactive.
